author: HopeTech
name: HopeTech.Common service tests
description: An xUnit fixture for one application service, plus the two fake ports it leans on. Fake ports and a real mapper - no mocking framework, no ASP.NET, no DbContext, no database. The unit half of the two tests every endpoint owes.

productNamespace.description: Root namespace of the project under test. The fixture lands in '<that>.Tests', which is the convention this base follows.

skipFakes.description: Omit the fake clock and fake current user, for a test project that already has them.
